chapter: Playing New Orleans and the coast
title: George Gaynor and the steamer contest against Fate Marable
summary: Gaynor's banjo, and the riverboat story where the Sam Morgan band outplayed the boat band.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Working the Streckfus riverboats with Fate Marable

blocks.x: Oh, do you remember when George Gaynor joined the band? He played with you, didn't he?
Well, he did after Johnny... after Johnny did.
Was he with you long? How long did he...

Oh yeah, he stayed with us a long time. George Gaynor stayed until we just broke up almost. He just said so wild and crazy. He can play pretty good banjo. I don't like the ghetto playing. He hits that old banjo so hard. Johnny had to build their dear What's the matter though? Everybody howl for the same long man, said, y'all better play. And every time we'd get on the stairs, that guy would go downstairs and we didn't know what it was all about. He cut that mic off, you see? So I seen him, I went downstairs, got out the stairs, went downstairs to see him doing something. And I come back and told the captain, I said, is nobody hearing nothing what we're playing coming up here? And the fella said, no, they got y'all cut off downstairs. So that started to mess up there with old fate, made him turn that mic on. Didn't want us to be here, you know what I mean? Of course the French market bunch was our bunch. You see, they was on the boat, riding on the boat that Sunday. They was going for Sam Morgan band. They wasn't worrying about the Fiat and Marble. He had, and that son had 10, 10 pieces, 12 pieces. And Dewey Jackson. And the man told him, says, I want to, before you all get down to that, the landing, say, I want to see what y'all going to do. And then people howling for Sam Morgan band. He said, well, we going to, say, just, we going to fix them. I said, yeah? All right, I'm going to hear. And he had one of these time clocks. Something that's set on there, times, time the music. He said, this band is hitting like a clock. And he says, he's going to play something. And they played a number. And I ain't forgot that number yet. And we didn't have that number. Well, that was all right. They didn't go for that. And we'd double around with some other old crazy song and toured feet to death. Well, anyway, we got that number. We got the name of that number and sent off and got it. And the father and son, we come back on that boat, and we played it for feet.
